narr: A weak disturbance moved through Central New York, producing some showers and thunderstorms. Moisture was high in the atmosphere, and storms were very slow moving, resulting in areas of torrential rain and flash flooding.
ev: Deep water was flowing rapidly across Highway 12 near Route 12A. Roads closed in the area.
Water flowing over County Highway 35 at Hickory Hill Road to the northeast of Milford.
Water over the bridge across Lake Brook on Factory Grounds Road.
Water from Wharton Creek was rapidly flooding areas at Bateman Road and Naylors Corner Road.
Rapid flooding was occurring over the road at State Highway 23 and County Highway 33 near West Harpersfield.
Rocks, mud, water and debris were blocking County Highway 33 at Betty Brook Road.
Town officials reported severe washouts at Teichmann Road and South Mongomery Hollow Road in the Town of Roxbury.
